name: Alexandria Company for Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries

valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2025, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 35.01 percent a year from FY2021 (1.17e+08) to FY2026 (5.248e+08), over 5 years
valuation.peEpsSource: net profit for FY2026 divided by the shares on file
valuation.pbFormula: price / (equity per share), equity on FY2025
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 5e+06 shares behind the market capitalisation (TradingView scanner (total_shares_outstanding); price 1335.59 EGP)
valuation.psFormula: price / (revenue per share), revenue on FY2026
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2026, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 5e+06 shares behind the market capitalisation (TradingView scanner (total_shares_outstanding); price 1335.59 EGP)
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 12.72, price over EPS 14.37); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
